findings.where: Hero, the two action buttons side by side ('Email us for launch news' and 'Explore destinations'), on desktop and phone
findings.fault: The two buttons have different corners. The coral button is a full pill and the outline button is a sharp, square-cornered box. Neither uses the brand's 8px control radius. Sitting next to each other, they look like they come from two different button sets, and the square box is the only hard corner on a page where the cards are rounded.
findings.who_objects: The founder and anyone keeping the brand system. DESIGN.md gives every button the 8px 'control' radius and keeps pills for badges and status chips. A visitor sees one rounded button and one square one in the hero's one action row, which looks unfinished rather than deliberate.

findings.fault: The outline button has no fill, so it is just a thin ink line on the turquoise. The brand's outline button has a white ground with an ink label. Here it reads as a bare frame drawn on the hero rather than the brand's quiet secondary button.
findings.who_objects: The founder. DESIGN.md sets the outline button's ground to white ('surface'), and the site's other outline controls, such as 'View beds' and 'Sign in', will be white. This one will not match them when the site goes live.

findings.where: 'Where we're starting' section, the region labels above each destination card name ('BALI', 'BALI', 'LOMBOK'), on desktop and phone
findings.fault: The region names are set in tracked capitals. The house casing rule keeps capitals for badges and filter labels only. A place name above a card title is neither, so it shouts slightly where the working-style cards should stay calm.
findings.who_objects: The founder, who keeps casing to sentence case and capitals to badges and filter labels, used sparingly. Once real badges appear, uppercase region names would blur the difference between a badge and a plain label.
